manifest.claim_text: Does structured regional state predict anything a pooled scalar cannot? (§11.4: structured regional state versus one scalar or pooled vector per region)
manifest.falsified_by: an equal-capacity, equal-compute control matches or exceeds the candidate, or the candidate wins only by smoothing away the effect of interest
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Collapse regional state to the supported dimensionality and stop describing regions as structured state spaces (body.tex §2.1) for the affected systems.
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No human stimulation protocol is implemented or implied: this is a deep-learning study on open data and there is no device command path.

It cannot distinguish modified source from a run writing its own log, so it is not recorded here and must not be gated on. Use source_dirty_paths.
